title: Pure Lightsworn
summary: Lightsworn cards only, with generic staples. Lightsworn mill their own Deck as a resource, and once four Lightsworn with different names are in the GY, Judgment Dragon summons itself and wipes the field. Charge of the Light Brigade mills three and searches, Solar Recharge draws two and mills two, and Raiden mills two more on your turn. Felis summons itself whenever a monster effect mills it, and Lightsworn Judgment searches Judgment Dragon when milled. The 2024 cards lead. Lightsworn Dragonling summons itself, mills a Lightsworn, and searches Judgment Dragon when it goes to the GY. Weiss, Lightsworn Archfiend revives a Lightsworn whenever it is milled. Minerva, the Athenian Lightsworn sends Lightsworn of different Types from the Deck. Lightsworn Aegis negates their cards and sets itself when milled. Curious, the Lightsworn Dominion is Forbidden.
